quiz.title: Solar System Quiz

questions.text: What will the Sun become as it expands late in its life?
questions.fact: The Sun will expand into a red giant before eventually leaving a white dwarf.

reference.quote: Because of its increased surface area, the surface of the Sun will be cooler (2,600 K (4,220 °F) at its coolest) than it is on the main sequence.

questions.text: Which inner planet, besides Mercury, is expected to be engulfed by the expanding Sun?
questions.fact: As the Sun expands into a red giant, it is expected to engulf Mercury and Venus.

reference.quote: The expanding Sun is expected to vaporize Mercury as well as Venus, and render Earth and Mars uninhabitable (possibly destroying Earth as well).

questions.text: Which object contains more than 99% of the mass in our solar system?
questions.fact: The Sun contains approximately 99.86% of the total mass of our solar system.

reference.quote: The Sun accounts for 99.86% of the Solar System's total mass.

questions.text: Which star lies at the centre of our solar system?
questions.fact: Our solar system is centred on the Sun, the star that the planets orbit.

reference.quote: NASA describes the solar system as including the Sun and its planetary system.

questions.text: What is the name of the planetary system that contains Earth?
questions.fact: Earth belongs to the Solar System, which includes the Sun and the objects orbiting it.

reference.quote: Astronomers sometimes divide the Solar System structure into separate regions.

questions.text: Which planet, together with Saturn, holds most of the solar system’s mass outside the Sun?
questions.fact: Jupiter and Saturn together hold nearly 90% of the mass outside the Sun.

reference.quote: Jupiter and Saturn possess nearly 90% of the non-stellar mass of the Solar System.

questions.text: Which gas giant, like Jupiter, is made mainly of hydrogen and helium?
questions.fact: Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants composed mainly of hydrogen and helium.

reference.quote: The Sun is composed of roughly 98% hydrogen and helium, as are Jupiter and Saturn.

questions.text: Beyond the Sun, which star is closest to us?
questions.fact: Proxima Centauri is our nearest stellar neighbour, about 4.25 light-years away.

reference.quote: The closest star to the Solar System, Proxima Centauri, is 269,000 AU (4.25 ly) away.

questions.text: Which cloud of interstellar gas surrounds our solar system?
questions.fact: Our solar system is in a region of interstellar gas called the Local Interstellar Cloud, also called the Local Cloud.

reference.quote: The Solar System currently moves through a cloud of interstellar medium called the Local Cloud.

questions.text: What force holds the solar system together?
questions.fact: Gravity binds the Sun and the objects that orbit it into the solar system.

reference.quote: The Solar System includes the Sun and all objects that are bound to it by gravity and orbit it.
